in_sanskrit.name: नागेश्वर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of all snakes, particularly the divine serpent Vasuki.

in_hindi.name: नागेश्वरारो
in_hindi.meaning: नाग: सर्प, श्वर: पति,त्मा, अरो: राजा, Lord of Serpents
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is the ruler or lord of all serpents.

in_tamil.name: நாகேஶ்வரரோ
in_tamil.meaning: நாகம்: ஸர்பம், ஶ்வரம்: அதிகாரன், அரோ: அழகியல், Lord of Serpents
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the lord or ruler of all serpents.

in_telugu.name: నాగేశ్వరరో
in_telugu.meaning: నాగే: సర్పమీదేశోదేశ, శ్వర: పోజ్జోటీ, అరో: అధికారి, Lord of Serpents
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the lord or ruler of all serpents.

in_marathi.name: Nageswararao
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Snakes
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nageswararao हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nageswara Rao is a combination of two words - Nageswara and Rao. Nageswara refers to the lord of snakes and Rao is a title of respect. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted as Nageswara, the lord of serpents. This name is believed to bestow courage, wisdom, and protection.

in_bengali.name: Nageswararao
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Snakes
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nageswararao একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nageswara Rao is a combination of two words - Nageswara and Rao. Nageswara refers to the lord of snakes and Rao is a title of respect. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted as Nageswara, the lord of serpents. This name is believed to bestow courage, wisdom, and protection.
